lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Crime (steal, rob, burglar, thief, witness, suspect, victim, evidence, police station).

aula.text: **Outras palavras:** witness (testemunha), suspect (suspeito), victim (vítima), evidence (provas), police station (delegacia), investigate (investigar), arrest (prender), fine (multa).

items: **rob + pessoa ou lugar:** *They robbed a bank. I was robbed.*
**mug:** assaltar uma pessoa na rua. *I was mugged on my way home.*
"They robbed my wallet." O certo é **They stole my wallet.**
"I was stolen on the street." O certo é **I was robbed** ou **I was mugged.**

lessons.title: Question tags
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Question tags (frase afirmativa, tag negativa; frase negativa, tag afirmativa) e a entonação delas.

head: Frase
Tag
Exemplo
rows: She isn't a witness, is she?

items: Use o mesmo auxiliar da frase: *You've called, haven't you? She can swim, can't she?*
Sem auxiliar, use do / does / did: *He lives here, doesn't he? They left, didn't they?*
Casos especiais: *I'm right, aren't I?* e *Let's go, shall we?*
**Entonação:** tag subindo é pergunta de verdade. Tag descendo é pedir confirmação do que você já acha.
"You are tired, isn't it?" Não existe uma tag fixa como o "né". O certo é **aren't you?**
"He didn't see anything, didn't he?" O certo é **did he?** (frase negativa pede tag afirmativa)

acc: You are tired, are not you?
you are tired, are not you?

exercises.prompt: He didn't see anything, didn't he?
acc: He didn't see anything, did he?
He did not see anything, did he?

lessons.title: Inglês prático, registrar uma ocorrência
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Registrar uma ocorrência.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: I'd like to report a theft. / My phone has been stolen. / My car has been broken into.
It happened at about 8 pm. / I was walking on... when... / I didn't see his face.
It's a black wallet. It contained my ID and some cash.
He was tall and was wearing a dark hoodie.
Yes, that's right. / No, I didn't. / Could you spell your name?
Could I have a copy of the report? / Will you contact me if you find it?

items: "It happened yesterday in the night." O certo é **yesterday at night** (ou **last night**).
"My phone was stole." O certo é **was stolen** (particípio).

exercises.prompt: It happened yesterday in the night.
Descreva em 2 frases um objeto que foi levado.
exercises.note: Resposta livre. Pratique esta ideia na conversa com o professor.
